items.title: Quick Start Guide
items.content: Welcome to Scladapp. This guide walks you through setting up your school, adding staff and students, and getting your first session running in minutes.

steps.desc: Head to Get Started and complete the school setup wizard. Enter your school name, address, and choose a subscription plan.
Navigate to the Staff section in your admin dashboard to invite teachers and other staff members.
Use the Students section to add students individually or import them in bulk via CSV upload.
Create your first academic session and assign classes, subjects, and teachers.

items.callout: Need help? Reach out via our Contact page and our team will get back to you within 24 hours.

items.title: System Requirements
items.content: Scladapp is a web-based platform that runs entirely in your browser. No installation is required for end users.

steps.desc: Chrome 90+, Firefox 88+, Safari 14+, or Edge 90+. We recommend Chrome for the best experience.
A stable internet connection with at least 5 Mbps download speed is recommended.
Minimum resolution of 1280×720. The platform is fully responsive on mobile and tablet.
Node.js 18+, MongoDB 6+, and at least 2GB RAM on your server.

items.callout: Scladapp works on all modern devices including smartphones and tablets.

items.title: Installation & Setup
items.content: If you are using the cloud version, no installation is needed — just sign up and go. For self-hosted deployments, follow the steps below.

steps.desc: Run: git clone https://github.com/scladapp/scladapp.git and navigate into the project folder.
Run npm install in both the root and backend directories.
Copy .env.example to .env and fill in your database URI, JWT secret, and other required values.
Run npm run dev to start both the frontend and backend in development mode.

items.callout: For production deployments, refer to our deployment guide or contact our support team.

items.title: Adding Students
items.content: Students can be added one at a time or imported in bulk. Each student gets a unique ID and a secure portal login.

steps.desc: From the admin dashboard, click Students in the left sidebar.
Click Add Student, fill in the student's details including name, class, and guardian contact.
Download the CSV template, fill it in, and upload it using the Import button.
After adding, assign each student to their class and arm for the current session.

items.callout: Student portal credentials are auto-generated and can be sent directly to guardians via SMS or email.

items.title: Managing Staff
items.content: Manage all teaching and non-teaching staff from one place. Assign roles, subjects, and classes with ease.

steps.desc: Click Staff in the admin sidebar to see all staff members.
Click Add Staff and fill in their personal details, role, and department.
From the staff profile, go to Assigned Subjects and link the subjects they teach.
Use the Payroll tab to set salary details and track payment history.

items.callout: Staff members receive login credentials to access their dedicated teacher portal.

items.title: Class & Session Setup
items.content: Sessions and terms define your academic calendar. Classes and arms organize your students.

steps.desc: Go to Settings → Sessions and click New Session. Set the start and end dates.
Within each session, create terms (e.g. First Term, Second Term, Third Term).
Go to Classes and add your class levels (e.g. JSS1, JSS2, SS1) with their arms.
For each class arm, assign a class teacher who will manage attendance and scores.

items.callout: You can run multiple sessions simultaneously if your school operates on a trimester or semester system.

items.title: Generating Reports
items.content: Scladapp generates printable report cards and detailed analytics for every student at the end of each term.

steps.desc: Navigate to Results in the admin or teacher dashboard.
Choose the session and term you want to generate reports for.
Teachers upload CA and exam scores for each subject from their portal.
Once all scores are in, click Generate Report Cards to produce printable PDFs for all students.

items.callout: Report cards include GPA, class position, teacher remarks, and principal comments.

items.title: Attendance Tracking
items.content: Track daily attendance for every student. View trends, flag absences, and notify guardians automatically.

steps.desc: Teachers access the Attendance section from their dashboard each school day.
Check off present students. Absent students are flagged automatically.
Admins can view attendance summaries per class, student, or date range.
Enable guardian notifications to send SMS or email alerts when a student is absent.

items.callout: Attendance data feeds directly into report cards and is visible to parents in the student portal.

items.title: Grade Management
items.content: Configure your grading system to match your school's standards. Supports percentage, letter grades, and GPA.

steps.desc: Go to Settings → Grading and define your grade boundaries (e.g. A: 70–100, B: 60–69).
Set the percentage weight for continuous assessment vs. exam scores per subject.
Teachers enter scores from their portal. The system calculates totals and grades automatically.
Admins review submitted scores before they are locked and included in report cards.

items.callout: Grade configurations can be set globally or customized per class level.

items.title: Authentication
items.content: The Scladapp API uses JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for authentication. All requests must include a valid token in the Authorization header.

steps.desc: POST to /api/auth/login with your email and password. The response includes an access token.
Include the token in all requests: Authorization: Bearer <your_token>
Tokens expire after 24 hours. Use the /api/auth/refresh endpoint to get a new one.
POST to /api/auth/logout to invalidate the current token.

items.callout: Keep your API tokens secure. Never expose them in client-side code or public repositories.

items.title: Endpoints Overview
items.content: The Scladapp REST API provides full access to all platform data. Base URL: https://api.scladapp.com/v1

steps.desc: GET /students — list all students. POST /students — create a student. GET /students/:id — get one student.
GET /staff — list all staff. POST /staff — create staff. PUT /staff/:id — update staff details.
GET /results/:studentId — get results for a student. POST /results — submit scores.
GET /attendance — list records. POST /attendance — mark attendance for a class.

items.callout: All endpoints return JSON. Errors follow the format: { success: false, message: '...' }

items.title: Webhooks
items.content: Webhooks let you receive real-time notifications when events happen in Scladapp, such as a new student being enrolled or a payment being made.

steps.desc: POST to /api/webhooks with your endpoint URL and the events you want to subscribe to.
Each webhook request includes an X-Scladapp-Signature header. Verify it using your webhook secret.
Your endpoint should return a 200 status within 5 seconds. Failed deliveries are retried 3 times.
student.created, student.updated, payment.received, result.published, attendance.marked

items.callout: Test your webhooks using our built-in webhook tester in the developer settings panel.
